'''2013 Alderaan Regionals''' was a Players Committee constructed regional, 13–14 July 2013, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="tdl">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ starwarsccg.org], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020044435/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive].</ref> Its decklists were published as the Alderaan Regionals PDF on the Players Committee decklist desk. The sheets are dated 13 July 2013, except [[Roy McCarthy]]'s Dark list, dated 14 July 2013. The same PDF also holds sheets from other events (California States, U.S. Nationals), which are not listed here.

Some sheets give other names: Camden Yanaga (username Cam Solusar) for [[Ganden Yanaga]], Matt HT for [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]], Shannon for [[Kevin Shannon]], and Chris Schowthyl (username imrhil327) for [[Chris Schoenthal]]. [[Tom]] and [[Nathan]] (the SoCal players) give first names only.
